title: augmented_oas — final specification closed by the final OAS gate (produced by Stage 3; decision record 000 §2.5, D4, D5, 004 D31–D33)
description: The hard boundary for all downstream analysis. A standard OpenAPI 3.1 document (full validity is checked by the vendored official meta-schema); each operation records, in x-carverflow-* extension fields, the set of observed responses, the evidence sources and the discovery/execution-readiness triage; Stage 4 dependency edges are written back into x-carverflow-dependencies. Since 013-C, operations newly discovered by probing still need a successful observation as proof; operations in initial_oas whose real UI-recorded responses are HTTP errors are also kept as discovery_only. cleanup/trust/material no longer decide whether an operation enters the OAS; instead x-carverflow-discovery.execution_readiness marks it ready or discovery_only. Responsibilities of the four x-carverflow fields: x-carverflow-observations = complete per-observation provenance (the ground truth); x-carverflow-observed-responses = a convenience summary aggregating response statuses; x-carverflow-evidence = a derived view for the existence decision; x-carverflow-discovery = discovery state and readiness for subsequent automatic execution.

operationId.description: Derived deterministically per D5, same rule as initial_oas

x-carverflow-observations.description: Inherited from D33: complete per-observation provenance (consumed by Stage 4 dependency inference / Stage 6 grounding). UI observations are carried over from initial_oas (source=stage1_session, keeping its run_id+entry_index and attribution fields); probe observations are appended (source=stage2_5_probe, probe_id referencing probe_results). Every admitted operation has at least one successful observation (D31 existence gate).

x-carverflow-observed-responses.description: Set of responses observed for this operation (including 4xx and other error codes — the gate only filters operation existence and does not suppress error-response records of confirmed operations)

source.description: Observation source: UI exploration session or constructed probe

x-carverflow-evidence.description: Evidence sources for the operation's existence (the basis on which the final OAS gate confirmed it)

ref.description: Reference to a session-bundle entry or a probe_id

x-carverflow-dependencies.description: Dependency edges written back by Stage 4 (producer→consumer edges this operation participates in), same shape as a dependency_graph edge

observation.description: One per-request observation provenance record (004 D33). Two branches by source: UI observations keep the initial_oas $defs/observation shape plus source; probe observations carry a probe_id referencing probe_results (there is no har entry, so the referenced object differs).

discovery.description: 013-C: once an operation has been discovered, an explicit triage of whether it is ready for subsequent automatic execution. A discovery_only operation may stay in the OAS catalog but must not be consumed directly by later Stage 4/5/6 as strong executable material.

existence_status.description: A UI-recorded HTTP response or a probe 2xx/3xx proves that the operation exists; error-only UI operations must remain discovery_only.

execution_readiness.description: ready may enter the subsequent automatic execution chain; discovery_only only means the API operation has been discovered while material/safety/cleanup are still insufficient.

reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons, e.g. cleanup_unverified, recorded_literal_assumption, material_insufficient.

ui_observation.description: UI exploration session observation (carried over from initial_oas, source=stage1_session).

run_id.description: run_id of the source session bundle (D20 reference shape)

entry_index.description: Entry index in har log.entries (D20 reference shape)

action_id.description: ID of the ui_action the observation is attributed to (mutually exclusive with orphan_class, D22)

orphan_class.description: Orphan class (mutually exclusive with action_id, D22)

confidence_tier.description: Confidence tier of the action attribution; absent for orphan observations

auth_present.description: Whether the request carried an authentication header (D24)

probe_observation.description: Constructed-probe observation (Stage 2.5, source=stage2_5_probe); probe_id references probe_results.

status.description: Probe response status (same domain as probe_results.response.status)

auth_present.description: Whether the probe request carried an authentication header (D29: reuse of the verified authentication)
